name: showwaves-classic
description: Scrolling waveform across the frame, square-root scaled so quiet passages still read.
author: ambient-streamer

parameters.name: thickness
parameters.label: Thickness
parameters.description: Expands the waveform stroke from one to four pixels.

parameters.name: weight
parameters.label: Weight
parameters.description: Scaled keeps a thin trace; full fills the whole envelope.

parameters.name: response
parameters.label: Response
parameters.description: Amplitude curve. Log and cbrt lift quiet passages.

parameters.name: split_stereo
parameters.label: Split stereo
parameters.description: Draw left and right as separate traces.
